sourceWitness.zh: 時老的沙執其事頗力，皇太子因惡之，而皇后又譖之於內，帝以老的沙母舅故，封為雍王，遣歸國。
sourceWitness.en: At that time Laodasha enforced the matter with considerable force, so the heir apparent hated him for it, and the empress also slandered him within the palace; because the emperor treated Laodasha as his maternal uncle, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Yong and sent him back to his domain.
